title: Certified Online Yoga Teacher Training Courses from Bali
metaTitle: Online Yoga Teacher Training Courses / Specialised Yoga Courses
metaDescription: Yoga Alliance certified Online Yoga Teacher Training Course and Specialised Yoga Courses from the top-leading yoga school in Bali.
intro: Enroll in our Yoga Alliance certified Online Yoga Teacher Training Course with Bali Yoga School. Our course materials are filmed and prepared in Bali and in Rishikesh, India. We offer a structured syllabus designed to give you a profound understanding of yoga fundamentals.

These self-paced courses include live online classes and pre-recorded sessions, covering each topic and subject with clear explanations and demonstrations. All classes are optimized for low internet speeds. Gain access to over 150+ pre-recorded HD quality yoga sessions in Meditation, Pranayama, Yoga Philosophy, Yoga Anatomy, Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga, and Hatha Vinyasa Yoga. You’ll also receive a digital PDF course manual to keep for life, plus one-year access to all our pre-recorded classes.

issues: Card link targets (hrefs) were not captured in the source audit; listedItems[].path values marked pathInferred=true were matched by card wording (hours/level/campus) to existing course URLs in pages-index.csv — verify against the live site.

500 h card is in-person copy on an online hub: 'You will be spending with like-minded people under the same roof for 2 months. Practicing and learning yoga intensely yet with a lot of joyful events and excursions'.
Part 1 / 100 h card says students can 'join live Zoom classes for an entire year', but the 100 h online course page mentions no live classes (pre-recorded only, 30 days–3 months).
Part 2 / 100 h card says 'within 3 to 6 months'; there is no Part 2 course page; the Part 1 page says 30 days to 3 months.
Hub intro says 'one-year access'; 15-day courses give one-month access and the 500 h page promises lifetime access.
Hub claims materials were 'filmed and prepared in Bali and in Rishikesh'; course pages say recordings were made in Rishikesh, India.
Title says 'Specialised Yoga Courses' but no specialised courses are listed on this page (they are on /online-specialized-yoga-courses/).

Typo on page: 'Lean More'. Unverified claims not used: 'top-leading yoga school in Bali', 'one of the premier yoga schools in the world', 'leading yoga school in Bali', 'top-tier professionals', 'the best yoga course you can ever find'.
